description: Source code for the ValidateAST class, which performs validation on an abstract syntax tree (AST) in the ANGLE project. It includes methods for traversing and validating AST nodes, checking for issues like multiple parents and null children.

classes.name: ValidateAST
classes.description: Class for validating an AST node tree, checking for structural issues such as multiple parents and null children.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Static method to validate an AST node with diagnostics and options.

methods.name: visitNode
methods.description: Visits a node and checks for multiple parents if enabled.

methods.name: expectNonNullChildren
methods.description: Checks that a node has at least a minimum number of non-null children.

methods.name: validateInternal
methods.description: Performs internal validation checks and returns overall validation result.
